prehistory_rule: use canonical exact-NY17 historical replay from 2021-09-01 through 2024-12-31 only to initialize lagged volatility, frozen event regime/extreme, FAST/SLOW states, and any warning state entering 2025
boundary_rule: if a warning is active at the first governed 2025 origin because of pre-2025 history, clip its episode start to that first governed 2025 origin; grant no pre-2025 lead-time credit but otherwise score it normally

role_replay.FAST: recompute from the exact canonical close history using the frozen R4 FAST implementation
role_replay.SLOW: recompute from completed W-FRI weekly closes using the frozen R4 SLOW implementation

claim_separation.structural_health_path_half: current condition/anatomy monitoring, not independent predictive evidence
claim_separation.challenge_success_claim: supports the integrated monitoring state machine only; does not establish an independent forecast gain attributable to PATH_HALF
